Name: ThreefoldReach
Architecture: Stitched timber, refugee bells, chalk waystones and argument-plastered inns
PublicPrinciple: A witnessed promise outranks an inherited seal.
Ritual: At first light two neighbors reread a road's name aloud, including those denied the original charter.
SoundDirection: Struck copper bells, wagon-wheel rests and overlapping spoken distances
VisualDirection: Mist gold and ink blue; stable landmarks before every camera turn
OptionalActivity: Repair a communal mile marker using testimony, never repeated commodity grinding
CentralDispute: Shelter requires trust; records demand difficult public consent

Name: WidowedRain
Architecture: Hollow boat-roofs, ledgers hung like prayer flags, dry harbors full of tide tools
PublicPrinciple: Water belongs to its keepers only while they can prove it was shared.
Ritual: A departing sailor leaves a dry cup on a sill for a sea not yet returned.
SoundDirection: Rain counted on glass, wet rope under wind, a bell with no answering buoy
VisualDirection: Desaturated jade and pewter; reachable high ground and rainfall visibility options
OptionalActivity: Compare a chart with a first-hand shoreline witness
CentralDispute: A broker sells remembered water to families who need actual rain

Name: HearthBeneath
Architecture: Carved heat channels, shared kilns and soot-marked kinship walls
PublicPrinciple: A fire is a promise to the next household, not hereditary property.
Ritual: Each street relights an empty hearth before feeding the communal flame.
SoundDirection: Low stone resonance, breath, hammers and furnace air
VisualDirection: Ember ochre, moss-black stone; non-flicker alternatives to fire flashes
OptionalActivity: Tend a heat channel and decide who receives warmth during shortages
CentralDispute: Protecting an ember can become a justification for excluding outsiders

Name: TidalLedger
Architecture: Debt boats on foundations, inverted tide clocks, names bound into pier slats
PublicPrinciple: Nobody may pledge the tomorrow of a person who cannot consent.
Ritual: A lender writes a due date, then washes the book and preserves the erased impression.
SoundDirection: Distant oar strokes without water, scratch of debt stylus, delayed bell
VisualDirection: Black teal with silver date-stamps; rising-tide warning indicators
OptionalActivity: Audit a ferry manifest by meeting a borrower and examining a physical seal
CentralDispute: Relief now may hide the architecture of generational exploitation

Name: SkyBelow
Architecture: Ceiling streets, hanging stairs, counterweighted houses and public score walls
PublicPrinciple: No building should stand by erasing the person holding it up.
Ritual: Neighbors sing a support note to each other before ascending.
SoundDirection: Voices above/below, stretched string harmonics, silent counted rests
VisualDirection: Lavender slate with gold tuning points; optional static camera horizon
OptionalActivity: Help a family adjust a counterweight after observing its true load
CentralDispute: Structural safety depends on forbidden unpaid labor

Name: CinderSpine
Architecture: Fossil ridges with family mortar, suspended quarry rails and layered graves
PublicPrinciple: Stone cut from history still belongs to the people erased with it.
Ritual: Quarry workers put a blank space in each wage ledger for missing ancestors.
SoundDirection: Stone groans, dry percussion and voices trapped in rock strata
VisualDirection: Ash-white and iron purple; cracks visibly widen before collapse
OptionalActivity: Make a safe brace from a documented material source
CentralDispute: The mine supports homes while it un-makes the lineages that built them

Name: HundredUnlived
Architecture: Addresses without numbers, consenting-door inscriptions, public thresholds with no census marks
PublicPrinciple: The right to be sheltered cannot depend on surrendering an origin.
Ritual: Hosts leave an unlabeled welcome cup and ask a guest how they wish to be addressed.
SoundDirection: Soft door clicks, unsent letters, footfalls that answer before they occur
VisualDirection: Fog cobalt and warm shelter amber; no flashing identity scan required
OptionalActivity: Help a guest reach shelter without giving up an identity
CentralDispute: Recognition may expose the very people it is meant to protect

Name: OrchardOfKings
Architecture: Root-grown bridges, vacant tribunals, communal fruit vaults and unoccupied crowns
PublicPrinciple: No law is just because its author wears a name.
Ritual: Gardeners recite dissenting votes before deciding where a communal root may grow.
SoundDirection: Leaves tapping crowns, underground creaks and deliberate empty applause
VisualDirection: Deep green and garnet with legible law marks on living bark
OptionalActivity: Regraft a public path by gaining consent from both sides
CentralDispute: Refusing power can conceal power exercised without consent

Name: FirstAbsence
Architecture: Thresholds without foundations, overlapping doorways and contested origin altars
PublicPrinciple: More than one remembered beginning may be true without erasing any witness.
Ritual: Each newcomer is asked what they need, not which history they belong to.
SoundDirection: Silent horizon pulses, doubled footfalls, an almost-remembered lullaby
VisualDirection: Obsidian with contrasting pearl outlines; stable horizon setting mandatory
OptionalActivity: Compare two truthful maps, keeping a safe return path open
CentralDispute: An imposed single origin would stabilize space by invalidating lives
